html:
SMTO-LLM-0075 — The model switch preview is out of date

GUID: 944bb893-ee88-51ae-9ad3-11c50ca55f5f
Slug: local-ai-activation-preview-stale
Domain: LLM · Subsystem: local_ai

What happened

  • Something changed since SMTO showed you the preview for switching models, or the preview is more than 10 minutes old. SMTO won't apply it, so a newer choice isn't overwritten.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open Settings › Setup › Model routing and look at the Main card to see which model and endpoint SMTO uses right now. If an earlier switch already went through, you don't need to apply it again.
  2. If Main isn't what you want, ask SMTO in a new message to preview switching to your local model again. A new preview is checked against the current settings, so it can't undo someone's newer change by mistake.
  3. Apply the new preview within 10 minutes, and don't edit Model routing in between. Previews expire after 10 minutes, and any settings change in between makes them out of date again.

What success looks like

  • The Main card in Settings › Setup › Model routing shows the model you chose.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't keep re-applying the old preview; ask for a new one each time.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The Local AI activation or restore was refused because its preview is missing, expired (10 minutes), already applied, or no longer matches the current profile revision or model routing configuration.

What this means

  • Activation/restore checks preview state, expiry, profile revision and current configuration revision; changed evidence invalidates the saved proposal. Local AI management belongs to the selected Gateway and accepted profile. Starting a runtime does not activate it for the controller; recorded execution and unknown-effect facts determine whether reconciliation is required.

Why this can happen

  • Activation/restore checks preview state, expiry, profile revision and current configuration revision; changed evidence invalidates the saved proposal.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare preview expiry and recorded before/after revisions with current controls; inspect applying/active/restoring state before issuing another change.

How to fix it

  • Check the current Main configuration in Settings › Setup › Model routing and the accepted profile revision (local_ai.profiles), then run a new activation_preview and apply it within 10 minutes without intervening routing edits. If an earlier activate_for_smto or restore_smto_endpoint was in progress, first confirm whether Main already matches its target before applying anything.
  • Refresh the preview for the intended model and review its changes; reconcile an already applying activation before repeating it.

Retry and execution caution

  • Only after exact state reconciliation.

How to verify the fix

  • A fresh preview matches current configuration and the accepted profile throughout activation.

What not to do

  • Do not replay uncertain mutations or stop externally owned processes.

Technical notes

  • Local AI management belongs to the selected Gateway and accepted profile. Starting a runtime does not activate it for the controller; recorded execution and unknown-effect facts determine whether reconciliation is required.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
